TIME_WINDOW: 2024-09-29 to 2024-10-05 corresponds to MMWR Week 40, the first week of the 2024-2025 influenza surveillance season; baseline activity is typically low at season start — expect minimal or low activity designations in most states.
DATA_AVAILABILITY: CDC FluView for MMWR Week 40 (2024-2025 season) may have been published with a 1–2 week lag; confirm report publication date before asserting data coverage.

CASE_COUNT_SEMANTICS: CDC does not report total national confirmed influenza case counts; primary metrics are percent positivity, ILI%, hospitalization rates, and pediatric death counts — do not expect a single national case total.
GEOGRAPHIC_COVERAGE: FluSurv-NET covers only select catchment areas (~9% of U.S. population); hospitalization data is not available for all states.
SUBTYPE_TRACKING: Record influenza A and B subtypes separately where reported; early season data may show limited subtype diversity.
VALIDATION: Cross-validate state-level reports against CDC FluView regional summaries to detect reporting inconsistencies.
EVIDENCE_QUOTE: Prioritize verbatim extraction of numeric data with surrounding context; include MMWR week reference and case definition language in evidence_quote field.
